Program Overview:
Darkness RISING Project is a non-profit organization dedicated to improving mental health awareness, addressing stigma, and connecting Black communities and marginalized groups with culturally competent mental health providers. Monmouth County residents can access its free downloadable resource guides, provider directory, and specialized therapy voucher programs online.

Key Services:
Black Mental Health Resource Packet & Provider Directory: Free downloadable guidance and provider listings to help individuals find Black mental health therapists, psychiatrists, and community wellness resources.
REBUILD Program: Connects justice-involved and formerly incarcerated individuals of color with therapists of color, providing up to 10 funded therapy sessions when vouchers are available. Signups are open online; vouchers and appointments are contingent on funding and availability.
Find Me a Therapist Directory: Online provider search tool connecting therapy seekers with culturally responsive clinicians (Direct matching service is currently at capacity; self-pay or insurance applies unless covered by a funded voucher).
